international.title: Labour rebellion over Rosebank oilfield expected to top 100 MPs
international.summary: Total of 75 have already signed letter to Burnham opposing plans as discontent also grows over Europe and welfare changes As many as 100 Labour MPs could sign a letter opposing the giant Rosebank oilfield, as discontent among backbenchers looks likely to surge this week, with rebellions also brewing over Europe and welfare changes. A total of 75 MPs have already signed the private letter, which is expected to be delivered in the next fortnight to Andy Burnham as part of a campaign in which Labour MPs from the party’s 2024 intake are playing a significant role.
